trans-unit.source: So, what are *your* plans once we go home?
trans-unit.target: So, what are *your* plans once we go home?

trans-unit.source: I haven't decided on much. I want to visit my mother for sure, though.
trans-unit.target: I haven't decided on much. I want to visit my mother for sure, though.

trans-unit.source: At her resting place. I've never had a chance to say goodbye...
trans-unit.target: At her resting place. I've never had a chance to say goodbye...

trans-unit.source: But, umm... Would you come along? I think Mother would want that.
trans-unit.target: But, umm... Would you come along? I think Mother would want that.
